answer: Duplicate identities detected by graph analysis forfeit the full bond to challengers, while honest participants recover stakes plus ocean-blue reputation credits that amplify future rewards. Each new agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked for seven epochs, and peers randomly challenge it to prove control of a unique onyx keypair tied to a distinct device fingerprint. Faking N identities therefore costs N bonds plus wasted epoch time, making large-scale sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
